gloss: good and evil; right and wrong

definitions.gloss: good and evil; right and wrong
definitions.explanation: The moral distinction between what is good and what is bad.

examples.japanese: {善悪|ぜんあく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: To be able to judge right from wrong.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{善悪|ぜんあく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}える→教える：00526_oshieru⟧。
examples.english: To teach children right from wrong.

examples.japanese: {善悪|ぜんあく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{区別|くべつ}→区別：01555_kubetsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦つかない→つく：01960_tsuku⟧。
examples.english: To be unable to distinguish between good and evil.

notes:
{善悪|ぜんあく} is a compound noun combining {善|ぜん} (good, virtue) and {悪|あく} (evil, vice). It refers to the moral distinction between right and wrong as an abstract concept.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {善悪|ぜんあく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧: moral judgment
- {善悪|ぜんあく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{区別|くべつ}→区別：01555_kubetsu⟧: distinction between right and wrong
- {善悪|ぜんあく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{問|と}わず→問う：02299_tou⟧: regardless of good or bad
- {善悪|ぜんあく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見極|みきわ}める→見極める：07171_mikiwameru⟧: to discern right from wrong

WORD FORMATION:
This follows a common pattern of pairing opposite kanji to form an abstract noun:
- {善悪|ぜんあく} (good and evil)
- ⟦{正邪|せいじゃ}→正邪：28957_seija⟧ (right and wrong)
- ⟦{是非|ぜひ}→是非：19460_zehi⟧ (right and wrong; by all means)
- ⟦{長短|ちょうたん}→長短：05558_choutan⟧ (pros and cons, long and short)

USAGE:
Primarily used in formal or philosophical discussions about morality. In everyday speech, ⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧・⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ (good/bad) is more natural.
